messages:
lucy: heads up — hit an intermittent auth failure in the ruby sampleapp when running inside the monorepo CI matrix. repro steps: run `./scripts/start-local.sh` then curl the /health endpoint

ben: can you paste the error?

lucy: sure — kube logs show repeated 401s during long-lived process test:
```
2026-03-12T14:02:03Z ERROR Request failed: 401 Unauthorized (invalid_token)
  client.rb: fetch_token -> refresh_token returned nil
```

ashwin: that looks like token refresh callback not firing in the multi-threaded server. Is the sampleapp using the new `refreshable_token` helper?

lucy: it's using our legacy pattern: `Redwood::Auth.client(token: ENV['REDWOOD_TOKEN'])`. In the monorepo setup we mount a shared gem from `../libs/common-auth` — maybe the env var isn't being propagated to spawned puma workers.

olga: fwiw the ruby sdk differs from go/js here — go has an internal callback hook that calls `on_token_expired { fetch_new }` and the default retry/backoff handles 401 -> refresh -> retry. Ruby's default retry was just a simple linear backoff, and we didn't wire in the refresh callback.

lucy: opened a tiny PR to experiment: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sampleapp/pull/214 — adds an integration test that simulates token rotation by writing a new token file and sending SIGHUP to the app. CI currently failing though.

ci-bot: build matrix failed: ruby-3.2 / integration (monorepo) — see logs: https://ci.redwood-inference.com/1841001234/build/17

ben: link looks like a flaky env leak. Can you add a failing-only reproduction locally and paste the minimal steps? That helps us avoid noisy CI reruns.

lucy: minimal repro:
```
# spawn two processes to simulate master+worker
REDWOOD_TOKEN=stale TOKEN_WATCH_DIR=./tmp ruby sampleapp/bin/server &
sleep 2
# replace token file
echo new-token > ./tmp/token && kill -USR1 `cat tmp/pid`
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer new-token" http://localhost:3000/api/generate
```
returns 401 until restart.

ashwin: thanks — sounds like we need three small changes: (1) expose a `on_token_refresh` callback in the ruby SDK, (2) wire retries to call it on 401 before failing, (3) add a test in the sampleapp and opt-in env var for monorepo users where process signaling is used. That will keep defaults safe for existing users.

olga: agree. also file a follow-up to align retry semantics with other SDKs — exponential backoff + jitter. We should put that under a `sdk-parity` label.

lucy: I'll update the PR. @ben can you review the test/CI changes once I push? Also adding a small docs note to the quickstart about token rotation in monorepos.

ben: will review after lunch. please add a changelog entry and tag @devex for a quick UX pass.

devex-bot: Reminder: add integration tests to the `monorepo` CI matrix only — toggled by `CI_MONOREPO=true`.

lucy: thanks all — pushing changes now. will follow up if CI still flakes. :thumbsup:
